description: This file contains benchmarking code for PyTorch tensor operations, including shape test cases, operator functions, and performance measurement routines, with command-line interface for running benchmarks with different configurations.

methods.name: rand
methods.description: Generates a tensor with random values scaled and shifted.

methods.description: Returns a tuple of two 2D tensors.

methods.description: Returns a tuple of tensors with broadcasting shape.
